focus.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期收官在即，中国出口企业须提前布局碳成本核算
focus.summary: 欧盟CBAM过渡期将于2026年底结束，2027年起进入正式征税阶段。近期欧盟委员会发布过渡期数据申报常见问题指南，强调进口商须确保申报数据完整准确。中国钢铁、铝、化肥等行业出口企业面临碳成本传导压力，建议尽快建立产品碳足迹核算体系，与欧盟进口商协同完成数据申报，并评估在欧盟境内设立实体的必要性。
focus.title_en: EU CBAM Transitional Period Nears End: Chinese Exporters Urged to Prepare for Carbon Cost Accounting
focus.summary_en: The EU's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) transitional period will conclude at the end of 2026, with the definitive regime and levy taking effect in 2027. The European Commission recently published FAQs on transitional data reporting, stressing that importers must ensure completeness and accuracy of declared data. Chinese exporters in steel, aluminium, and fertilisers face pressure to pass through carbon costs. Companies are advised to establish product carbon footprint accounting systems, coordinate with EU importers on data reporting, and assess the need to set up EU entities.

case.title: 新加坡高等法院承认中国法院商事判决，跨境债权追索路径进一步拓宽
case.summary: 近期新加坡高等法院依据《选择法院协议公约》及普通法规则，在一起中资企业间的跨境合同纠纷中承认并执行了中国法院的商事判决。该案明确了中新两国在无双边条约背景下，通过普通法路径承认中国判决的可行性。对于在新加坡有资产的中国债权人，此案提供了可操作的追索范式，建议在跨境合同中约定新加坡法院管辖或选择仲裁，并提前调查债务人资产分布。
case.title_en: Singapore High Court Recognises Chinese Commercial Judgment, Broadening Cross-Border Debt Recovery Options
case.summary_en: The Singapore High Court recently recognised and enforced a Chinese commercial judgment in a cross-border contractual dispute between Chinese-owned entities, relying on the Hague Choice of Court Convention and common law principles. The decision confirms the feasibility of recognising Chinese judgments in Singapore via the common law route absent a bilateral treaty. For Chinese creditors with assets in Singapore, this case offers a workable recovery model. It is advisable to include Singapore court jurisdiction or arbitration clauses in cross-border contracts and to investigate debtors' asset distribution in advance.

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动便利化再升级，企业需关注“白名单”与安全评估衔接
policy.summary: 近期广东省网信办等部门进一步优化粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动便利化措施，扩大适用“白名单”机制的行业范围，并简化低风险数据出境的安全评估流程。对于注册在大湾区、面向港澳开展业务的企业，建议梳理数据出境场景，优先申请纳入“白名单”，同时完善内部数据分类分级制度，确保与《个人信息保护法》及跨境传输新规衔接，降低合规成本。
policy.source: 来源：广东省互联网信息办公室 · 2026.10
policy.title_en: Greater Bay Area Cross-Border Data Flow Facilitation Upgraded: Firms Need to Align 'Whitelist' with Security Assessment
policy.summary_en: Authorities in Guangdong, including the provincial cyberspace administration, have further optimised cross-border data flow facilitation measures in the Greater Bay Area (GBA), expanding the industry scope of the 'whitelist' mechanism and simplifying security assessment procedures for low-risk outbound data transfers. Companies registered in the GBA and doing business with Hong Kong and Macao should map their data export scenarios, prioritise whitelist inclusion, and refine internal data classification and grading systems to align with the Personal Information Protection Law and new cross-border transfer rules, thereby reducing compliance costs.
policy.source_en: Source: Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province · Oct 2026

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对华投资限制新规落地，企业应重构跨境交易架构与合规防火墙
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国近期进一步收紧对华半导体、人工智能等敏感领域的投资限制，并扩大“美国人”定义范围。中国出海企业应重新审视跨境融资与并购架构，避免引入受限制的美国资本或人员；同时建立交易对手筛查机制，在合资、许可等安排中嵌入合规陈述与保证条款。建议企业提前进行供应链与股权穿透分析，必要时调整投资路径，并保留法律意见以应对潜在审查。
analysis.source: 来源：律连全球 · 秦林蒿律师 · 2026.10.21
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: New US Outbound Investment Restrictions on China Take Effect—Firms Should Restructure Cross-Border Deals and Build Compliance Firewalls
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The United States has recently tightened outbound investment restrictions on sensitive sectors such as semiconductors and artificial intelligence involving China, and broadened the definition of 'US persons'. Chinese outbound companies should re-examine cross-border financing and M&A structures to avoid introducing restricted US capital or personnel. They should also establish counterparty screening mechanisms and embed compliance representations and warranties in joint venture and licensing arrangements. Companies are advised to conduct supply chain and equity penetration analyses in advance, adjust investment paths where necessary, and retain legal opinions to address potential reviews.
analysis.source_en: Source: iGlobal Law · Attorney Qin Linhao · 2026.10.21
